#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

mkdir -p out
pass=0
fail=0

check() {
  local name="$1" input="$2" expected="$3"
  printf '%s\n' "$input" > out/test.calc
  python3 src/compiler.py out/test.calc out/test.py
  local actual
  actual="$(python3 out/test.py)"
  if [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]]; then
    echo "PASS: $name"
    pass=$((pass + 1))
  else
    echo "FAIL: $name — expected '$expected', got '$actual'"
    fail=$((fail + 1))
  fi
}

check "simple addition"   "print(1 + 2)"       "3"
check "precedence"        "print(2 + 3 * 4)"   "14"
check "parentheses"       "print((2 + 3) * 4)" "20"
check "division"          "print(10 / 4)"      "2.5"
check "negative result"   "print(1 - 5)"       "-4"
check "multiple prints"   "print(1)
print(2)"                                 "1
2"

echo "$pass passed, $fail failed"
[[ $fail -eq 0 ]]
